race.comment: FEHMARN (1) is coming off a solid win at Cranbourne to make it three wins from six starts, dashing best over this trip to score by half a length. Sets up well in the first few again and can go on with the job. MCKEYLA (6) resumes. She was beaten as favourite first up in town last campaign, tackling a couple of better races thereafter. Off a long break so watch the betting. HOTSPUR REALE (10) resumed with an even run at Ballarat over this trip. Fitter for that and should be hard to hold out. CRANK (12) resumes having put up a good number on debut at Terang before struggling in town. Wary fresh.
